market_summary: USD and safe-haven flows dominate during the London/NY overlap. Indices and crypto face persistent selling pressure, with US100 breaking below value area low and key support for a valid scalp continuation. FX pairs EURUSD and GBPUSD remain choppy within their respective value areas near session VWAP, while BTCUSD is severely stretched into session low support.

signals.rationale: EURUSD is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.10801 to VAH 1.10976) and trading below session POC 1.10928. Cumulative Delta is NEUTRAL (+4,771) with positive slope. Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price sits right at the VWAP (1.10861) and just under EMA50 (1.10884). ATR channel is expanding with price testing mid-channel. RVOL printed 1.697 without a recent yellow spike on the signal bar. After a sweep below Prev Low 1.10824, the forming candle bounced back above VWAP but lacks directional expansion or delta conviction outside the value area. HOLD is prudent.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral consolidating around VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: GBPUSD is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.32593 to VAH 1.32778) and trading below POC 1.32738. Cumulative Delta is BEARISH (-5,833) with negative slope (-1,760.62). Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price is capped below VWAP (1.32656) and EMA50 (1.32677). ATR channel is expanding while price hovers mid-to-lower band. RVOL was moderate at 1.063 with yellow volume spikes earlier in the breakdown. Price rejected overhead S/R at 1.32661, but remains trapped mid-range above VAL 1.32593 and Session Low 1.32500 without clean continuation volume, warranting a HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below declining VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: US100 is trading below VAL (28081.85) and well below POC (28120.74). Cumulative Delta is BEARISH (-3.27) with a slight positive slope. Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Trend is solidly bearish under both VWAP (28121.69) and EMA50 (28130.78). ATR channel is expanding with price hugging the lower red ATR band (27953.94). Dukascopy tick volume RVOL is 1.249 (absence of yellow bars expected on this CFD feed). Signal bar pushed down through S/R 28030.0 and the forming bar is confirming acceptance under 28030.0 targeting Session Low 27912.13. GEX context is null. Valid momentum short setup.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish sustained below VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: BTCUSD is trading below VAL (73260.85) and well below POC (73517.38). Cumulative Delta is BEARISH (-0.07) with negative slope (-0.02). Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price is deep beneath both downward-sloping VWAP (73371.34) and EMA50 (73264.39). Price is riding below the lower ATR band (72397.07), highly extended after a major cascade. RVOL is 1.518, following a yellow RVOL climax bar 3 bars ago. Price is pressing directly into Session Low support at 72155.80; selling directly into stretched lower ATR bands and key session support without a pullback creates poor risk-reward. HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish sharp extension below VWAP and EMA50
